Save Share X (twitter.com) Facebook Mail Ballot Box 2026 Election Hub Your ballot, voting information and the latest updates Right Tuesday is Election Day, and a record number of Minnesotans have voted early . Early voting — in person, by mail or through an absentee ballot — has become increasingly popular for people who hope to avoid lines or cast their ballots when it’s convenient for them. 
 And this year, Minnesota introduced a new process that allows early voters to place their ballots directly into the machine that counts them, just as they would on Election Day.
 Coming up at 9 a.m. on Tuesday, MPR News host Angela Davis talks with her guests about why so many Minnesotans chose to vote early, how voting habits are changing and what Minnesotans should know if they’re heading to the polls on Election Day.
 And we want to hear from you, too.

 Guests: 
 Amy Perna is the executive director of the League of Women Voters of Minnesota , a nonpartisan organization dedicated to voter education and civic engagement. She leads the organization’s efforts to encourage voter participation, improve access to voting and help Minnesotans make informed decisions at the ballot box. 
 Michael Minta is a professor and director of graduate studies in political science at the University of Minnesota. He is also the author of “ No Longer Outsiders: Black and Latino Interest Group Advocacy on Capitol Hill.”
